mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation_summary (conversation_id, segment_id, topic, content, start_message_id, covered_message_id) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{segmentId}, #{topic}, #{content}, #{startMessageId}, #{coveredMessageId})

INSERT INTO ai_conversation_summary (conversation_id, segment_id, topic, content, start_message_id, covered_message_id) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{segmentId}, #{topic}, #{content}, #{startMessageId}, #{coveredMessageId}) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id, segment_id) DO UPDATE SET content = #{content}, covered_message_id = #{coveredMessageId}, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, segment_id, topic, content, start_message_id, covered_message_id, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_conversation_summary WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY segment_id ASC

SELECT id, conversation_id, segment_id, topic, content, start_message_id, covered_message_id, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_conversation_summary WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND segment_id = #{segmentId} LIMIT 1
